correctness.rationale: Let B be unsigned incidence of fixed labeled host G and Y retained-edge indicators under Uu+Uv≥1. Direct conditional integration gives Cov(Y_e,Y_f)=1/4 for e=f,1/12 when distinct edges meet,0 when disjoint, hence 12Cov(Y)=I+BᵀB, and 12Σ=BBᵀ+(BBᵀ)^2=Q+Q². PSD Q and principal root give Q=(sqrt(I+48Σ)-I)/2. In the Sylvester equation TX+XS=48(Σhat-Σ) both square-root spectra are ≥1, so ||Qhat-Q||F≤12||Σhat-Σ||F; <1/24 gives binary adjacency recovery, with empty-host and bipartite-nullity cases handled. Independently checked exactly all 1,099 labeled graphs on 1–5 vertices by edge-pair covariance and Q polynomial.
